subtasks: Our starting point is in a seating area. We are facing a window, with a chair and a bench beside it. Turn around and exit through the door between the two curtains.

Now you are facing a table with books on top. Turn right. You will come across two doorways; walk towards the doorway on your right and walk past the hallway. Turn left, leaving the small round table on your right. You will come across a staircase; do not go down. Walk past the staircase towards the right. There is a hallway on your right; do not walk into the hallway. Then move towards the left. In front of you there will be a long window. Walk towards the right side of the window. That is your destination.
